item.title: MJR Morning Brief — November 26, 2026
item.description:
From Media Jobs Report, here's your MJR Morning Brief.
TelevisaUnivision has renewed its partnership with the Chicago Bears through 2027. Latino Mix 93.5 FM will continue broadcasting all preseason and regular-season games in Spanish, with streaming available on the Uforia app. Omar Ramos, known as Omarcillo, returns as Lead Commentator. The agreement also includes fan events and expanded multimedia coverage.
Turning to television,
CNN will celebrate the 20th anniversary of its Heroes All-Star Tribute on December fifth. Miley Cyrus will accept the CNN Heroes Legacy Award honoring Dolly Parton. Jon Bon Jovi, Wynonna Judd and Edward Norton are among the celebrity presenters, with Anderson Cooper and Laura Coates hosting the special.
In radio news,
Philadelphia’s ninety-three point three W-M-M-R and its Preston and Steve morning show collected more than one point one million pounds of food and raised over one point one three million dollars during their twenty-ninth annual Camp Out for Hunger. The donations will support more than three hundred community partners across Pennsylvania and New Jersey.
Turning to television,
Snoop Dogg is bringing some star power to Christmas this year. NBC's new holiday special, “Christmas with Snoop,” airs December second, following “Christmas in Rockefeller Center.” The celebration features Gwen Stefani, Jamie Foxx, Martha Stewart, Kristin Chenoweth and more. The special streams the next day on Peacock.
In radio news,
Audacy's La Grande 107.5 in Dallas raised $22,500 during its third annual Chiquilin Swing For The Future Golf Tournament. Morning Host Armando “El Chiquilin” Ulloa led the event benefiting Los Primos Dallas, which provides mentorship and educational support to first-generation Latino students. The organization has helped more than 250 students since 2018.
And finally,
This Thanksgiving, all of us at Media Jobs Report want to express our heartfelt appreciation to our users, partners and vendors. We are grateful for your continued support, trust and friendship throughout the year. We also extend a special thank you to the dedicated media professionals working this holiday to keep our communities informed, entertained and connected. From our family to yours, we wish you a happy, healthy and wonderful Thanksgiving. Thank you for being part of our journey.
For the latest media news, job openings, free tools and more, visit MediaJobsReport.com.
